attachment_semantics.close: arm grasps the named object at action completion when it is unowned
attachment_semantics.open: arm releases the named object at action completion when it owns it
attachment_semantics.transfer_authority: requires stationary dual grasp inside the frozen handover zone

resource_semantics.acquire: succeeds only when the named resource is unowned
resource_semantics.release: succeeds only for the current owner
resource_semantics.simultaneous_acquire: two acquisitions at the same logical instant are a violation
